what: Three layers of wavy hills across the section head undulate at different speeds. Six points bob by 30 each on a sine (the center point also moves 8 sideways) and are joined by a Catmull-Rom curve, while the back layer (pale) · middle layer · front layer move at .2 · .25 · .5 so the hills roll out of step. Phones·tablets (1279px and below) stretch the waves .8x and draw at 30fps only.

options.amp: Rise and fall (units based on 1524 width), default 30
options.--fx-back·--fx-middle·--fx-front: Layer colors, default --kf-raised, --kf-accent-soft, --kf-accent — the front layer takes the background color of the section below

use: …

from.where: shared.js .an-wave (a hill of primary color draped over the top of each section. Original wave_component: 6 points · base 80/90/100 · amp 30 · speed .2/.25/.5 · phase 0/1.4/1.4 · width multiplier 1/1.5/1.5, time × .0015, frequency ×.8 and 30fps at 1279px and below)
